summary: Moves a projectile forward with optional gravity, and returns it to a pool if it came from one.
overview: Drop it on a projectile prefab. It moves forward each frame with optional gravity drop and removes itself on lifetime or first hit — detecting a PoolableObject on the same object and releasing through that instead of destroying, so the same prefab works pooled or not.
useCases: Bullets, arrows and grenades from a pool.
An arcing ballistic shot, via gravity.
Any projectile that should not need separate pooled and unpooled versions.

params.tuning: Zero is a straight shot; anything above starts an arc. This is acceleration, not a one-off drop.
Remember triggers are hit by default, so a checkpoint or pickup volume will end a projectile's flight unless excluded.

gotchas.title: It detects hits by raycasting ahead, and should have no collider
gotchas.body: Without a collider it also cannot be hit by another projectile's ray. Adding one to "make it collide" breaks both properties.

gotchas.title: Triggers stop it unless masked out
gotchas.body: Physics.queriesHitTriggers defaults to true. Put non-blocking volumes on the Ignore Raycast layer and exclude that layer.
